title: Abu Dhabi firm launches first UAE-registered US dollar stablecoin
summary: Abu Dhabi’s Universal Digital has launched USDU, the first US dollar‑backed stablecoin registered by the UAE central bank under its Payment Token Services Regulation.

title: Swiss bank Sygnum raises over 750 BTC for market-neutral fund
summary: Sygnum says its market-neutral BTC Alpha Fund posted 8.9% annualized returns in Q4 and raised more than 750 Bitcoin from professional and institutional investors.

title: ETH exchange supply shrinks as staking grows amid sideways price
summary: The validator entry queue for the Ethereum network is heavily congested, with 3.6 million ETH lined up to be staked with a forecasted 63-day wait.

title: Cere Network co-founder and board face $100M lawsuit over token sales
summary: Cere Network is facing a second lawsuit this month that accuses its co-founder and board of fraud in relation to a public token launch for the platform in 2021.

title: XRP millionaire wallets are ramping up in ‘encouraging sign’: Santiment
summary: The rise in XRP wallets holding more than 1 million tokens comes despite a weakening of broader crypto market sentiment, with a popular crypto indicator sitting in “fear” territory.

title: Gold nearly adds Bitcoin’s entire market cap in a single day
summary: Gold is now also outperforming Bitcoin over the last five years, having risen over185%, while Bitcoin is up only 164% over the same period.

title: Bitcoin rallies expected to be short-lived until liquidity returns: Data
summary: Bitcoin price breakouts fail to hold due to insufficient bid-side liquidity. Glassnode analysis identifies the key metrics that are likely to mark the next phase of BTC price expansion.

title: SEC gives guidance on issuer vs third-party tokenized securities
summary: The US regulator defines tokenized securities as issuer- or third-party-sponsored, stressing that blockchain issuance does not bypass federal securities laws.

title: Worldcoin spikes 40% as OpenAI reportedly plans biometric X rival
summary: A small team is developing the platform, according to sources, which may integrate ChatGPT for content creation while using biometrics for proof-of-personhood.

title: US senators quiz deputy AG over DOJ crypto unit shutdown
summary: The six US senators cited a sharp rise in illicit crypto activity in 2025 to argue that the DOJ should not have disbanded its cryptocurrency enforcement team.
